user.title: ClimateSync – Step 1: Source Rooms
user.description: Select one or more climate entities (rooms) whose heating demand ClimateSync will track. Each room must expose a current temperature and a target temperature.

destination.title: ClimateSync – Step 2: Destination & Settings
destination.description: Select the thermostat that ClimateSync will control. Choose **Target temperature** for ordinary climates or **Lower target temperature** for a heating range climate. For a lower target, ClimateSync preserves the current upper target in the same action.

data.idle_temperature: Idle temperature (°C) – used when no room needs heating
data.max_setpoint: Maximum setpoint (°C) – hard ceiling for the destination setpoint

error.no_sources: Please select at least one source climate entity.
error.dest_is_source: The destination thermostat cannot also be a source room.
error.destination_target_unsupported: The selected destination does not currently expose the chosen target. A lower target also requires a valid upper target.

init.title: ClimateSync – Step 1: Source Rooms
init.description: Change which climate entities (rooms) ClimateSync tracks for heating demand.

destination.title: ClimateSync – Step 2: Destination & Settings
destination.description: Change the destination thermostat and adjust all settings. Choose **Target temperature** for ordinary climates or **Lower target temperature** for a heating range climate. For a lower target, ClimateSync preserves the current upper target in the same action. **Demand activation threshold**: room delta required to start heating. **Demand deactivation threshold**: lower delta at which heating stops.

data.idle_temperature: Idle temperature (°C) – used when no room needs heating
data.max_setpoint: Maximum setpoint (°C) – hard ceiling for the destination setpoint

error.no_sources: Please select at least one source climate entity.
error.dest_is_source: The destination thermostat cannot also be a source room.
error.demand_threshold_order: The deactivation threshold must be lower than the activation threshold.
error.destination_target_unsupported: The selected destination does not currently expose the chosen target. A lower target also requires a valid upper target.
